# Subway Seat for Vim

True-colour and 256-colour definitions in one file, with groups for ALE, coc, vim-lsp, GitGutter, NERDTree, fugitive and more, plus lightline and airline themes. `colorscheme subway-seat` follows `background`, so `set background=light` gives you Enamel.

[Vim](https://www.vim.org) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/vim/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.vimrc:

```vim
set termguicolors
colorscheme subway-seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.vimrc:

```vim
set termguicolors
colorscheme subway-seat-tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.vimrc:

```vim
set termguicolors
colorscheme subway-seat-enamel
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
